'''2018 European MPC Results Jordi Paul LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jordi Paul]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jordi Paul]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Concentrate All Fire|DS2-L-concentrateallfire.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
